How sizes, downloads and totals are verified

Scope: 104 entries: the 93 supplied spreadsheet entries plus 11 LANL scientific collections. The default plan preserves the spreadsheet’s 75 selected entries and adds the 11 LANL collections. The “All file packages” preset includes additional large packages but excludes remote services, unspecified COVIS scope, and the HD(CP)² single-step subset when the full series is selected.

  • Reported size: green labels preserve source-reported sizes. All 104 entries have a source-size audit in their expanded details. Green identifies provenance, not byte-exact precision. Open SciVis uses the supplied HTML snapshot; the other entries use the linked publisher metadata and listings.
  • Components and files: when the source lists separate sizes, the row preserves those components or explicitly shows a per-file range. Numeric totals sum the reported component values and remain estimates; these sums are not presented as publisher-reported collection totals.
  • Units: source labels do not change when display units are switched. Conversions use decimal units unless documented otherwise. Open SciVis uses binary units despite kB/MB/GB labels; LANL Apache K/M/G/T listings use binary units. Rounded values retain an ≈ marker in totals.
  • Hosted data: JHTDB reported capacities are explicitly labeled and excluded from download totals. Missing collection totals, variable file examples, and calculated payload sizes are not relabeled as reported download totals.
  • Unknown: missing values are never treated as zero. A subtotal with unknown entries is incomplete. Remote database capacities and payloads for one field/time unit stay outside local totals.
  • Duplicates: archive and expanded LANL copies are not added together. HEAT uses full CYL fp16 plus original PLI archives. HD(CP)² single-step and full-series selections are mutually exclusive. Bunny CT, brain MRI and Miranda variants remain separate file representations; they may overlap scientifically.
  • Working storage: each row identifies its scope: scalar payload, stored data files, or an unpacked estimate. Expanded HDF5 alternatives are kept separate from archive download sizes. These values do not establish complete extraction, peak disk-space or memory requirements.
  • Links: “Download RAW” and “Download archive” target files; “Download page” and “Browse files” open publisher listings. Registration and service links are labeled. Sources were checked on 8 October 2026 UTC; some responses are cached. Reported byte lengths came from the retrieval service’s Content-Length limit messages. Archive content-type responses confirm a file target but do not verify its full transfer. Fifteen mantle-convection part links returned HTTP 404. Full binary transfers and checksums remain unverified.

Main sources:Open SciVis · Maintained RAW manifest · LANL Oceans 11 · SDRBench. Expand any row for its specific source and size basis.
